newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Colonial, RAMS launch Visa card.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Colonial, RAMS launch Visa card.

text.p: Colonial State Bank and the RAMS Home Loans mortgage originator said on Monday they would launch a joint Visa card to be known as RAMS Visacard.
RAMS and Colonial said the credit card would be funded by Colonial and would have the same interest rates as Colonial's own credit cards.
Currently, Colonial's credit card had a 13.2 percent basic interest rate, compared to the larger bank's rates of 16 to 18 percent, Colonial said.
They said the card would be launched in April, and therefore might not have the same interest rates as those currently available.
RAMS managing director John Kinghorn told a news conference additional features might be added to the card later.
RAMS marketing director Greg Jones said these features could include some type of "Fly-buys" customer loyalty arrangement or a similar arrangement for whitegoods products.
RAMS said eventually Australia's credit card market would be transformed by the securitisation of credit card receivables.
"Securitisation of credit card receivables are the way of the future," Kinghorn said.
However, RAMS would not enter the credit card receiveables market on its own because it preferred to concentrate on the securitisation and marketing of home loans.
Kinghorn said RAMS expected to make an announcement on some new initiatives later on Monday.
